title: Publish, lock and amend grades; student grades page
agent_directive: This JSON is the complete task spec. First read docs/prompts/_standards.json once, then load the skills in `skills`. Read only the `spec_sections` of docs/fypms-docs.md (grep the FR id; never open the whole file). Build only what `build` lists and reply with `reply_format` from _standards.json.
build: src/app/actions/publish-grades.ts (coordinator/admin): pre-flight check per team (scores_summary complete; deliverable signed off). Failures are returned as a list; the coordinator may pass override {justification} for missing sign-offs (audited grades.publish_override). Effects in chunked batches: evaluations.is_published true, team.scores_summary.is_locked true, team.status completed, academic_years.grades_published true with grade_published_at and grade_appeal_deadline = now + 7 days; notify every team member (grade_published); writeAudit grades.published. Idempotent.

src/app/actions/amend-grade.ts (coordinator only): input teamId, new supervisor_score / panel_average_score / composite_final_score, written justification (min 20 chars); writes the new values with Admin SDK, audits grades.amended {old, new, justification, timestamp}, notifies the team (system).

/grades student view: before publication a LockedCard; after publication the team's final mark prominently, supervisor and panel components, per-criterion breakdown from the now-readable evaluations, and the appeal window countdown (appeal form arrives in 11-03).
/grades coordinator view: publish panel with the pre-flight checklist, type-to-confirm 'PUBLISH', and an amend dialog.
Tests: pre-flight lists failing teams, publish is idempotent, amend audits old/new, rules test confirms evaluators and students cannot write evaluations after publication.
acceptance: After publish no client can modify an evaluation
Students cannot see marks before publish
Amendment writes a complete audit entry
